notes.title: Update and Optimization
notes.content:
[b]Optimization[/b]:
The game now delivers a little more fps than before.
At low fps, allied monsters move more smoothly than before.
 
[b]Changes in the balance[/b]:
Minimal changes to the balance. Rebalancing the tavern

[b]Bug fixes[/b]:
At high levels, everything works more smoothly
Fixing a bug with the tavern

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Slight increase in difficulty
Support for 16:10 screens
